title: The Donkey, the Cat and the Lion’s Head
title_raw: THE DONKEY, THE CAT AND THE LION’S HEAD
year_evidence: 扉に『PUBLISHED BY THE AMERICAN FOLK-LORE SOCIETY … 1924』、序文の署名に『April, 1924.』
text:
Joseph Macfarlane, Moneague, St. Ann.

One day a donkey an’ a cat was out trab’ling an’ when dey went half
way, dey saw some lion head, an’ de cat pick i’ up, put i’ in de donkey
hamper. An’ when dey went round de corner, dey saw two lions working on
de road, an’ dey lef de hamper roun’ de corner wid de lion head. De
lions said, “We are jus’ having breakfas’!” De Donkey an de Cat said,
“We have plenty!” Donkey said, “Brer Puss, you go tek up de lions’
heads fe see which one we eat to-day.” Puss went, took up de head an’
said, “Dis one?” Donkey said, “De odder one.” An’ said, “Dis one?”
Donkey said, “De odder one,” till dey count about twenty (when it was
only one). De lions whisper to each odder, say, “Dey kill so many lion
one day, what you t’ink of we couple?” An’ dey eat an’ went home.
paragraphs: One day a donkey an’ a cat was out trab’ling an’ when dey went half way, dey saw some lion head, an’ de cat pick i’ up, put i’ in de donkey hamper. An’ when dey went round de corner, dey saw two lions working on de road, an’ dey lef de hamper roun’ de corner wid de lion head. De lions said, “We are jus’ having breakfas’!” De Donkey an de Cat said, “We have plenty!” Donkey said, “Brer Puss, you go tek up de lions’ heads fe see which one we eat to-day.” Puss went, took up de head an’ said, “Dis one?” Donkey said, “De odder one.” An’ said, “Dis one?” Donkey said, “De odder one,” till dey count about twenty (when it was only one). De lions whisper to each odder, say, “Dey kill so many lion one day, what you t’ink of we couple?” An’ dey eat an’ went home.
語り手 ジョゼフ・マクファーレン(セントアン、モニーグ)

ある日、驢馬と猫が旅に出て、道の半ばまで来たとき、獅子の頭が落ちているのを見つけた。猫はそれを拾い上げて、驢馬の籠に入れた。それから角を曲がると、獅子が二頭、道普請をしていた。二人は獅子の頭の入った籠を角の向こうに置いてきた。獅子たちは言った。「おれたちはちょうど朝飯を食ってるところだ!」 驢馬と猫は言った。「おれたちは有り余ってるよ!」 驢馬が言う。「猫どん、獅子の頭を取り出して、今日はどれを食うか見てくれ」。猫は行って頭を取り上げ、「これかい?」と言った。驢馬は「別のだ」と言う。また「これかい?」 驢馬は「別のだ」。そうやって二十ばかりも数えた(ほんとうは一つしかないのに)。獅子たちはたがいにささやいた。「一日にあんなに獅子を殺す奴らだ、おれたち二匹くらいどうだと思う?」 そして飯を食って家へ帰ってしまった。
